headline: Congress keeps the lights on with a pro forma session as both chambers prepare to return after Labor Day recess.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session on Thursday, August 27, meeting for just 33 seconds before adjourning. No legislative business was conducted as the chamber headed into the extended recess period.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly on August 27 for just three minutes, introducing 34 new bills and 8 resolutions while filing 19 committee reports. No votes were taken as the chamber wound down before the recess.
